ImageListView.summary: Image list view, a LayoutPanel subclass that scans a VFS directory and shows images as "icon + filename" items with directory navigation and selection.

props.classname: Class name string, "imagelistview", used to identify the control type.
props.autosize: Fixed to true: the view resizes its own height to the flow layout result.
props.autoArrangeH: Switch for automatic distribution of horizontal leftover space. Default false.
props.autoArrangeV: Switch for automatic distribution of vertical leftover space. Default false.
props.centerItems: Fixed to false: children are not centered inside their cells.
props.iconX: Icon item width in pixels. Default 64; the item control is iconX+10 wide.
props.iconY: Icon item height in pixels. Default 64; the item control is iconY+20 tall.
props.itemMargin: Outer margin per child {left, top, right, bottom}. Default {1, 1, 1, 1}.
props.selectable: Fixed to true: items can be selected with the mouse.
props.multiSelect: Fixed to true: shift/ctrl multi-selection is allowed.
props.items: Item name list of the current directory: the first entry is always '..', followed by subdirectories and then image files.
props.dir: Directory path currently scanned (a VFS path). Defaults to an empty string; the constructor immediately calls SetDir with it.
props.OnDirChange: Event table fired when the directory changes; callback receives the new directory path as directory.

ImageListView:New.desc: After the parent constructor it immediately runs SetDir(obj.dir) to scan and display the initial directory.

ImageListView:_AddFile.desc: Creates a child LayoutPanel with rows=2/columns=1 (containing a passive Image and a centered Label) for one item and calls AddChild (internal).

ImageListView:ScanDir.desc: Lists the current directory with VFS.DirList/VFS.SubDirs, keeps image extensions via image_exts, and rebuilds the items list and all child controls (first entry '..'); the work is wrapped in DisableRealign/EnableRealign.

ImageListView:SetDir.desc: Calls DeselectAll, set dir from the argument then ScanDir, then fires OnDirChange; with a parent it calls RequestRealign, otherwise UpdateLayout + Invalidate.

ImageListView:GotoFile.desc: Splits the file path into directory and filename, switches directory, scans, then selects the file; when the parent is a scrollpanel it also centers the scroll position on the item.

params.filepath: full path of the target file

ImageListView:Select.desc: With a number it calls SelectItem by index; with a string it matches the filename against items and falls back to the first item when nothing matches.

ImageListView:DrawItemBkGnd.desc: Draws the item background with DrawItemBackground in the "selected" or "normal" state depending on whether the item is selected, expanding by itemPadding.

ImageListView:HitTest.desc: Forwards to the parent HitTest to find a child first, then hit-tests items through _cells; returns self when an item is hit.

ImageListView:MouseDblClick.desc: Double-clicking the first item goes to the parent directory, double-clicking a subdirectory enters it, and double-clicking an image file fires OnDblClickItem(items[idx], idx).

fileDesc: Defines ImageListView, which scans a VFS directory and shows images as icon-plus-filename items with directory navigation, file lookup and selection.
